text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Pale blue short jacket with dark gray pointed collar and small silver buttons, white shirt, black wide jeans with rolled hems, black shoes.. Add ONLY these accessories: A black narrow necktie with a small silver geometric crest near its middle.; A medium black soft leather handbag with short rounded handles and relaxed slouchy body.. Use each accessory once. Neckties are tied with one knot and the narrow tail hidden; for sweater layers tuck the long tail under the sweater. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Create ONE complete photorealistic hollow wardrobe outfit on a pure white background, portrait 2:3, soft studio light. FIRST reference is the exact clothing base; preserve its cuts, colors, layers and footwear. Other references are individual accessory products belonging to this look. Garments: Pale blue short jacket with dark gray pointed collar and small silver buttons, white shirt, black wide jeans with rolled hems, black shoes.. Add EXACTLY these accessories and no others: A black narrow necktie with a small silver geometric crest near its middle.; A medium black soft leather handbag with short rounded handles and relaxed slouchy body.. Arrange as a single cohesive empty outfit: tie at collar, belt at waist, scarf draped naturally, hat/eyewear hovering above empty neck if present, necklace around empty collar; bag beside hip with full strap. Watches, gloves or small jewelry can be placed neatly beside outfit, each once. No visible person, body, face, skin, hands, legs, mannequin, stand or hanger. Empty neck and sleeves. Preserve fully visible garments, shoes, accessory shapes, full chains and straps within frame. No source photos, collages, labels, text, props or watermark.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
